The region of the selected workspace. The default value will use the Region selection above.

properties.displayName: Authentication ASIM filtering parser for Halcyon
properties.query:
let parser = (starttime:datetime=datetime(null), endtime:datetime=datetime(null), username_has_any:dynamic=dynamic([]), targetappname_has_any:dynamic=dynamic([]), srcipaddr_has_any_prefix:dynamic=dynamic([]), srchostname_has_any:dynamic=dynamic([]), eventtype_in:dynamic=dynamic([]), eventresultdetails_in:dynamic=dynamic([]), eventresult:string='*', disabled:bool=false) {
    HalcyonEventsV2_CL
    | where not(disabled)
        and class_uid == 3002                                    // OCSF Authentication
        and (isnull(starttime) or coalesce(HalcyonSourceTime, TimeGenerated) >= starttime)
        and (isnull(endtime)   or coalesce(HalcyonSourceTime, TimeGenerated) <= endtime)
    | extend
        EventType   = "Logon",
        _filter_name = tostring(unmapped.halcyon_filter_name),
        EventResult = "Failure"
    | extend EventResultDetails = case(_filter_name in~ ("IncorrectPasswordAttempts", "FailedPassword"), "Incorrect password", "Other")
    // Pushdown filters on raw OCSF fields.
    // NOTE: targetappname_has_any and srchostname_has_any are not applicable - these authentication
    // emits no target application name and no source hostname (only a parsed source IP).
    // ipv4_is_in_any_range used for srcipaddr (clean IP string, not a log haystack) - see vimNetworkSessionHalcyon.
    | where (array_length(eventtype_in) == 0 or EventType in~ (eventtype_in))
        and (array_length(eventresultdetails_in) == 0 or EventResultDetails in~ (eventresultdetails_in))
        and (eventresult == '*' or EventResult =~ eventresult)
        and array_length(targetappname_has_any) == 0
        and array_length(srchostname_has_any) == 0
        and (array_length(username_has_any) == 0 or tostring(user.name) has_any (username_has_any))
        and (array_length(srcipaddr_has_any_prefix) == 0 or ipv4_is_in_any_range(tostring(src_endpoint.ip), srcipaddr_has_any_prefix))
    | extend
        SrcIpAddr      = tostring(src_endpoint.ip),              // parsed from the source log; empty when no parseable value is present
        TargetUsername = tostring(user.name),                   // attacked account; empty when no regex match
        TargetUserId   = tostring(user.uid),                    // always empty in the source data
        TargetDvcId    = tostring(dst_endpoint.uid),            // logon target asset
        DvcHostname_raw = tostring(dst_endpoint.hostname),
        EventOriginalSeverity = tostring(severity)
    | invoke _ASIM_ResolveDvcFQDN('DvcHostname_raw')
    | extend
        TargetHostname = DvcHostname,
        DvcAction   = case(action_id == 2, "Deny", action_id == 1, "Allow", ""),
        EventSeverity = case(
                            EventOriginalSeverity in~ ("Informational", "Info"), "Informational",
                            EventOriginalSeverity =~ "Low", "Low",
                            EventOriginalSeverity =~ "Medium", "Medium",
                            EventOriginalSeverity in~ ("High", "Critical", "Fatal"), "High",
                            EventOriginalSeverity =~ "Unknown", "Informational",
                            "Informational"),
        TargetUsernameType = _ASIM_GetUsernameType(tostring(user.name)),
        TargetUserIdType   = "",
        TargetDvcIdType    = iff(isnotempty(tostring(dst_endpoint.uid)), "Other", ""),
        DvcIdType          = iff(isnotempty(tostring(dst_endpoint.uid)), "Other", ""),
        EventStartTime = coalesce(HalcyonSourceTime, TimeGenerated)
    | extend
        Dvc          = coalesce(TargetDvcId, DvcHostname),
        EventEndTime = EventStartTime,
        User         = TargetUsername,
        IpAddr       = SrcIpAddr,                                // required ASIM alias of SrcIpAddr
        Src          = SrcIpAddr,                                // recommended; source identifier (attacker IP, may be empty on regex no-match)
        Dst          = TargetHostname,                           // recommended; logon-target host
        EventCount   = int(1),
        EventUid     = HalcyonEventId,
        EventOriginalUid = HalcyonEventId,
        EventMessage = tostring(message),
        EventOriginalType = tostring(type_name),
        EventOriginalSubType = tostring(activity_name),
        EventProduct = "Halcyon",
        EventVendor  = "Halcyon",
        EventSchema  = "Authentication",
        EventSchemaVersion = "0.1.4",
        AdditionalFields = bag_pack(
                              "halcyon_alert_id",    tostring(unmapped.halcyon_alert_id),
                              "halcyon_tenant_id",   tostring(unmapped.halcyon_tenant_id),
                              "halcyon_event_kind",  tostring(unmapped.halcyon_event_kind),
                              "halcyon_filter_name", _filter_name,
                              "halcyon_raw_log",     tostring(raw_data)
                          )
    | project-away DvcHostname_raw, _filter_name
};
parser(starttime=starttime, endtime=endtime, username_has_any=username_has_any, targetappname_has_any=targetappname_has_any, srcipaddr_has_any_prefix=srcipaddr_has_any_prefix, srchostname_has_any=srchostname_has_any, eventtype_in=eventtype_in, eventresultdetails_in=eventresultdetails_in, eventresult=eventresult, disabled=disabled)
